items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: That was Lewis and that boy. They had a little band. Lewis Armstrong had a little band

ctx.x: We were wondering, when you first started in music, did you have any lessons? Did you say guitar was your first instrument or how did you get started?

No, no, but you see my brother was locked up in the waveform. You know, talking about Jones. That was Lewis and that boy. They had a little band. Lewis Armstrong had a little band and a man by the name of Dave, he's still living here. They call him Professor Dave. And they used to go back there and lesson. Well I was trying to play the clan that day, you see. And me and a fella by the name of Jimmer Brown and another dog fella played trumpet. Well let's see what his name is. He died there too recently a few years…
Did you have another, well there's one guy named Shots back there.

items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: I know him from a kid.

ctx.x: Boy, he was a kid. And what about, uh, could he, you ever hear him play piano?

No, I never heard him play piano. He might have picked it up maybe when he got married, eh? I tell you one thing, though, that fellow, you see him? All the way he came on, that's just natural. They know put no, they know nothing to add on to his life. That's just natural. And that's the way he always was, from a kid. I know him from a kid. Always joking, killing, and laughing, make all kinds of spaces and everything. That's natural. That ain't nothing, no, no put on, no special gestures. Nothing, that's just…
Before you mention Blar and Gilbert, did you know him well?
